# GoreeCloud Webspaces — Third-Party Brand Asset Notices

GoreeCloud Webspaces packages local provider marks only to identify built-in Webspace destinations. Their inclusion does not imply sponsorship, endorsement, partnership, or affiliation. Provider names and trademarks remain the property of their respective owners.

## Simple Icons assets

The local Google, Meta, and Proton SVG marks are sourced from the Simple Icons project (`simple-icons/simple-icons`). The Simple Icons repository publishes its icon work under CC0 1.0 Universal. Trademark rights are not waived by CC0 and remain with the respective brand owners.

- `icons/providers/google.svg` — Google mark, Simple Icons
- `icons/providers/meta.svg` — Meta mark, Simple Icons
- `icons/providers/proton.svg` — Proton mark, Simple Icons

Source: https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons
License: CC0 1.0 Universal

`icons/providers/microsoft.svg` is derived from the Microsoft brand icon in Font Awesome Free 7.3.1 by Fonticons, Inc. The SVG source carries the upstream attribution comment and the icon is licensed under CC BY 4.0.

## GoreeCloud assets

`icons/providers/goreecloud.svg` and `icons/providers/standard.svg` are existing first-party GoreeCloud visual assets copied from the canonical GoreeCloud website repository. They are not third-party assets.
